# Town of Derby municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 7; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Derby Selectboard members: Grant Spates (Chair), Gwen Bailey-Rowe, Steve Gendreau, Bradley Shattuck, and Brian Smith.

Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table lists Grant Spates (3-year term expiring 2028), Brad Shattuck (2027), Stephen Gendreau (2-year term expiring 2027), Brian Smith (term expiring 2026), and Lindsay Brainard in the 2-year seat expiring 2026.

Town of Derby Annual Town Meeting Minutes, March 2, 2026 (derbyvt.org): the March 2, 2026 annual meeting record and the directory agree that Gwen Bailey-Rowe won the 2026 two-year seat (Brainard did not run again) and Brian Smith remains seated for the seat that stood in 2026.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table lists Faye C. Morin as Town Clerk, elected to a 3-year term expiring 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Faye Morin as Town Clerk of Derby.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table lists Faye C. Morin as Town Treasurer, elected to a 3-year term expiring 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Faye Morin as Town Treasurer of Derby.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the officer table lists Douglas Spates as Moderator with his elected term expired 2025 and marks him '(appointed)'.

Town of Derby Annual Town Meeting Minutes, March 2, 2026 (derbyvt.org): Douglas Spates presided as Moderator at the March 2, 2026 annual meeting. The March 3, 2026 ballot outcome for the moderator seat is published nowhere and the town's current Municipal Directory leaves the moderator name blank, so he is recorded as the appointed holder.

Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table lists Mark Linton (expiring 2028), C. Michael Marsh (2027), and Nancy P. Moore (term expiring 2026).
Town of Derby Municipal Directory page (derbyvt.org, current): the current Municipal Directory seats the same three listers (printing 'Mike Marsh'), so Moore remains in the seat that stood in 2026.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the 2026 Warning, Article 1, elects a Collector of Delinquent Taxes for a 1-year term.
Town of Derby Municipal Directory page (derbyvt.org, current): the current Municipal Directory names Maryann Tetreault as Collector of Delinquent Taxes.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table prints 'Mathew R. Sheltra' as First Constable (term expiring 2026).
Town of Derby Municipal Directory page (derbyvt.org, current): the current Municipal Directory seats Matthew Sheltra as First Constable; the directory spelling governs the name recorded here.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table prints the Second Constable seat as Vacant.
Town of Derby Municipal Directory page (derbyvt.org, current): the current Municipal Directory seats Jerry Bosley Jr as Second Constable, the winner of the 2026 ballot seat.

Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table lists five Cemetery Commissioners on 5-year terms: Elizabeth Bumps (2027), Scott Bianchi (term expiring 2026), James Buchanan (2029), and Valerie P. Glover (2028), with the fifth seat shown as a vacant remainder.
Town of Derby Municipal Directory page (derbyvt.org, current): the current Municipal Directory seats Bianchi in the seat that stood in 2026 and names Karen Jenne as the fifth commissioner.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the report's appointed-officers column names Grant Spates and Brad Shattuck as Town Agent.

Town of Derby Municipal Directory page (derbyvt.org, current): the current Municipal Directory pairs the same two names as Town Agent. The town fills this appointive office with two agents jointly, so the post carries two seats.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the report's appointed-officers column names Stephen Gendreau as Road Commissioner.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Derby justices of the peace: Lindsay Brainard, Elizabeth Bumps, Roseanna Cyr, Frank Davis, Sharron Greenwood, Allyson Howell, Karen Jenne, Alson Loukes, Brian Smith, Douglas Spates, Elia Spates, and Lona Stuart.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table lists the same twelve justices of the peace.

The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
Town of Derby 2025 Annual Town Report (derbyvt.org, February 2026): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICIALS table lists the same twelve justices of the peace.
